form:FormGroup.label: Profile Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: A unique name for this processing profile. Processor filters refer to the profile by this name.

form:FormGroup.label: Node Group
form:FormGroup.helpText: The node group whose nodes may run tasks for filters using this profile. If the group is disabled, no tasks run.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Only nodes in this group run tasks for this profile.

form:FormGroup.label: Processing Schedules
form:FormGroup.helpText: The periods when filters using this profile may process data, each with optional thread limits. No processing happens outside all of these periods.
